desc: Formalize feasibility for a fixed target sum T, separating fixed-fixed, fixed-wildcard, and wildcard-wildcard pairings.
Derive constraints and candidate ranges for T using counts of fixed B values and availability of fixed A entries.
Account for A_i=-1 as arbitrarily assignable values and B_i=-1 as unconstrained, including cases where both sides are wildcards.
Design an O(N^2) feasibility check suitable for N<=2000 and values up to 1e9.
Implement the final stdin/stdout solution and verify samples, boundary cases, and brute-force small cases.
